journey.name: Onboarding — sign in with Pubky Ring
journey.description:
First-run sign-in via the Pubky Ring deeplink auth flow against the staging homeserver. Requires: Loopky debug build installed, Pubky Ring installed and already set up with an identity (staging). Loopky must be signed out (fresh install or after Settings → Sign out).
Warning before running this: signing out is only reversible if the auth relay (`httprelay.pubky.app`) is reachable *from the app's Rust HTTP stack*, which on the emulator it intermittently is not — for stretches of ~15 minutes, while Chrome on the same emulator loads the relay over TLS and homeserver + Nexus reads keep working. There is no other way back into a signed-out session. Do not sign out unless you are willing to lose it.
The second half of this journey covers that failure, which is the more common outcome on the emulator and is the reason #59 exists: the poll used to be retried in place against an auth flow the FFI had already consumed, which replaced the real cause with "No auth flow in progress" and blamed Pubky Ring for a relay outage.

actions.action: Verify the onboarding screen is shown with the headline "Learn anything, remember everything." and a "Sign in with Pubky Ring" button (resource-id: onboarding_signin)
Verify the Pubky Ring app opens with an authorization prompt for Loopky's capabilities
Approve the authorization request in Pubky Ring (tap its confirm/authorize control)
Verify Loopky returns to the foreground and lands on the Home screen (a greeting header is shown and the bottom tab bar is visible)
THE RELAY-FAILURE BRANCH. Force it deterministically by disabling the radios before tapping sign in: adb shell svc wifi disable && adb shell svc data disable
Tap the element with resource-id "onboarding_signin", then return to Loopky (Pubky Ring still opens; press back or re-launch MainActivity)

Verify the onboarding screen shows "Loopky signs you in through Pubky's authorisation relay, and it isn't responding. Try again in a moment." — NOT "You're offline" (the relay is a different host from the homeserver) and NOT "Loopky couldn't confirm the authorisation with Pubky Ring" (Ring never saw the request)

Verify logcat contains "complete: FAILED — PubkyError: Auth approval failed" carrying the real transport error, and does NOT contain "awaitApproval: transport failure" or "No auth flow in progress" — either would mean the retry removed in #59 is back
Re-enable the radios, then tap "onboarding_signin" ONCE

Verify a single tap starts a whole new flow — logcat shows "state=Starting, calling beginSignIn" and a new authUrl with a different secret, and Pubky Ring reopens. The FFI auth flow is single-use, so restarting is the only recovery; a tap that merely clears the error is the two-tap regression #59 fixed.
